versions.name: DT Extractor
versions.text: {{KW:MAGIC}}: Send your hand to your deck. Add a copy of each unique {{TRIBE:AMALGAMATE}} in your dustpile to your hand with -1 {{COST}}.
versions.note: Not listed in Version History for this card; assumed Beta 60.1 (the earliest it could be - seen by 2021-07-15).

versions.name: DT Extractor
versions.text: {{KW:MAGIC}}: Swap your deck and dustpile. If your dustpile had more cards, take {{DMG}} and lose max {{HP}} equal to the difference.
versions.note: Also includes Beta 70.1 (the tracker saw them together).
